KSA Luxury Residential · Competitive Intelligence

Whose ad is on Diriyah's land?

A twelve-month census of luxury residential paid Meta activity in Saudi Arabia, ownership classified against the canonical lists at diriyahcompany.sa and wadisafar.com. Each ad is bucketed to the residence it promotes, and to the camp that owns that residence. Period: 2025-05-06 to 2026-05-06. Empty buckets are dropped.

Five takeaways

What stands out

  1. Diriyah's official sites list 14 branded residences across the master plan and Wadi Safar; only 1 run paid Meta in window.
  2. Competitors filled the void on Diriyah-owned land: 5 third-party residences advertised inside Diriyah territory.
  3. Rayana product line (DarGlobal) and Trump Mansions at Rayana carry the loudest competitor voice on Wadi Safar plots.
  4. ROSHN Sedra and Red Sea Global both out-spend Diriyah Company on Meta in Saudi Arabia.
  5. Diriyah Company's own page ran exactly 3 ads in 2025-05-06 to 2026-05-06; one was an Armani Residences Diriyah creative.
Method

How this was built

Sources, scope, and disclosed limitations
  • Canonical residence list sourced 1:1 from diriyahcompany.sa/en/diriyah-living and wadisafar.com/en/hotels. Anything on those pages is classified as Diriyah-owned. Anything else advertising in Diriyah territory is a competitor.
  • Each Diriyah-relevant Meta page (developer, brokerage, master plan, hospitality operator, architecture firm, parent developer) was opened via its Ad Library advertiser view and scrolled exhaustively. Captured 2026-05-07.
  • Window: 2025-05-06 to 2026-05-06 (twelve months). Geo: Saudi Arabia. Active and inactive ads both included. Authentication-walled platforms (TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Snap) are out of scope.
  • Each ad is bucketed to one or more residences by scanning copy, image content (brand logos / project name overlays), and landing-page URL. Where copy mentions a Diriyah-region master plan but no specific residence, the ad is bucketed to the most-specific generic line (Rayana, Sedra, Red Sea, AMAALA before Diriyah / Wadi Safar).
  • Body matching is restricted to each ad's own card text. Adjacent ads in the same DOM root are stripped before keyword scanning so that, for example, a M.A.D. Muscat ad on the DarGlobal page does not falsely match Trump Mansions copy from the next card.
  • Brokerage and architecture pages whose creative is out of scope for this brief were excluded.
  • Brands and residences with zero ads in window are not rendered. Absence is signal, but not design furniture. Diriyah-owned residences with zero in-window ads are listed in the audit trail above for completeness.
  • Variant images were captured for ads where Meta's detail page exposed the full creative; the count reflects locally cached variants, which can differ from Meta-reported figures.
Audit trail (Diriyah-owned, no in-window KSA Meta ads): Manazel Al Hadawi, Aman Residences Diriyah, Baccarat Residences Diriyah, Corinthia Residences Diriyah, Raffles Residences Diriyah, Ritz-Carlton Residences Diriyah, Amansamar (Aman Wadi Safar), Oberoi Wadi Safar Residences, The Chedi Wadi Safar Residences, Faena Wadi Safar Residences. Pre-sales (no ads expected): Montage Wadi Safar Residences, WELL Wadi Safar Residences, Six Senses Wadi Safar (hotel-only).
